SUB:
Six talismans exist in this World,
bearing mysterious powers and prosperity.
Six Dragon eggs, the sacred Dofus,

And with that, the elements were unleashed, 
Monsters sharpened their fangs,

Adventurers brandished their weapons,
And there was joyous carnage!

But the time has come!
Your destiny now takes you to Incarnam...
Choose your path as a knight, a healer or a summoner.

Find the Dofus,
And become the hero the World has been waiting for!
